notes: Sourced from BSS Audio's official BLU-806DA datasheet (PDF), which includes a labeled rear-panel photograph confirming connector types. The chassis has 4 field-configurable card slots (A-D), each accepting one of six I/O card types (Analog In, Analog Out, Digital In, Digital Out, AEC In, Telephone Hybrid), 4 channels per card, using pluggable Euroblock terminal blocks (S/+/- per channel); actual signal direction and count depend on which cards are installed (up to 16 of any given I/O type across all slots, max 16 total I/O). The datasheet's rear-panel photo shows all 4 slots populated with analog-style cards, which is reflected here, but real-world units may have a different card mix or empty slots. Dante/AES67 Primary and Secondary ports and the separate control Ethernet port do not have a stated Ethernet speed in the datasheet (grade eth-100m is an inference based on typical Dante Ethernet ports of this product generation, not explicitly confirmed in the source - treat with medium confidence for those three grade values specifically). BLU link ports are a proprietary BSS digital audio bus (256 ch) run over standard Cat5e/RJ45 cabling, not general-purpose Ethernet data, so no grade was set for them. RS232 is a female DB9 connector per the photo. Power is auto-switching IEC C14 inlet, 100-240V 50/60Hz, 55W, fuse protected. Device is formerly named "BLU-806", later revised as "BLU-806DA" (Dante/AES67-equipped); model field reflects both names as they are used interchangeably by BSS and retailers.
